meaning: One who is / Someone in the position of (requires high standard of conduct)
mnemonicOrNote: Used with high social roles (leaders, doctors, educators) to state duty.
exampleJapanese: 指導者たるもの、常に誠実で公平でなければならない。
exampleReading: しどうしゃたるもの、つねにせいじつでこうへいでなければならない。
exampleRomaji: Shidousha taru mono, tsune ni seijitsu de kouhei de nakereba naranai.
exampleEnglish: A true leader must always be honest and fair.

reading: きわまりない / のきわみ
meaning: utterly, nothing could be more... (the height of)
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Na-adj stem + 極まりない / Noun + の極み. Literary and emphatic expression of utmost emotional or descriptive state.
exampleJapanese: そのような無責任な言動は遺憾極まりない。
exampleEnglish: Such irresponsible behavior and remarks are utterly regrettable.

japanese: 〜をおいてほかにない (None other than / Only)
meaning: none other than, no one else but
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Noun + をおいてほかにない. Declares an entity to be peerless and exclusively suitable.
exampleJapanese: この難局を打開できる指導者は彼をおいてほかにない。
exampleEnglish: There is none other than him who can overcome this dire crisis.

japanese: 〜たるもの (One who is / In the position of...)
meaning: as a person who is, given one's status as
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Noun + たるもの. Prescribes ideal virtue and moral conduct expected of someone in a distinguished position.
exampleJapanese: 医者たるもの、常に患者の生命を第一に考えるべきだ。
exampleEnglish: As a physician, one must always put the patient's life first.

japanese: 〜ともなると / 〜ともなれば (When it comes to...)
reading: ともなると / ともなれば
meaning: when one reaches the stage of, when it becomes
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Noun / Verb [Plain] + ともなると. Describes natural escalation of expectations or situation when reaching a high level.
exampleJapanese: 国家元首ともなると、一言一句が世界情勢に直結する。
exampleEnglish: When one becomes a head of state, every single word connects directly to world affairs.

japanese: 〜余儀なくされる (Be compelled to / Forced to)
meaning: be forced to, be compelled to against will
mnemonicOrNote: Formation: Noun + を余儀なくされる. Describes being driven into an unavoidable or disadvantageous situation by external forces.
exampleJapanese: 悪天候により航路の変更を余儀なくされました。
exampleEnglish: Due to bad weather, we were forced to alter our navigation route.
